mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as a low rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation. This mechanism is always active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is measured, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 215.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering a monetary tightening cycle that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (mo-mo < 0), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a worsening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS monthly change < 0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 8.0% signals a severe labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 value below 11500 signals a weakening economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 11500, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 signals strong economic activity, causing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
